Sophia L. (CSM): @here kicking off onboarding for Vervain Labs 14 want to lock owners, success criteria, and a lean 30/60/90 to share with the account. :wave:

Rahul P. (SE): I'll own tech pairing. Need to confirm whether they want sandbox keys or will bring redacted test data.

Marta G. (AE): I'll track commercial milestones 14 renewal due in ~11 months, so let's set an adoption milestone at day 60 to lower renewal risk.

Eli T. (Onboarding): Draft cadence: Kickoff + weekly 45m enablement sprints x6. Proposed 30/60/90:
- 30d: integration + smoke tests, first two use-cases live
- 60d: perf baseline, prompt library, cost tuning
- 90d: scale plan and handoff to CS ops

Sophia L. (CSM): Please paste 2 acceptance criteria each so I can make a one-pager.

Rahul P. (SE): Tech acceptance:
- API flows end-to-end with sanitized data
- KV cache/session continuity working; p95 latency target for demo traffic <200ms

Marta G. (AE): Commercial acceptance:
- Exec sponsor confirms value hypothesis
- PO/Procurement target date set and renewal baseline logged in Salesforce

Eli T. (Onboarding): Enablement acceptance:
- Two internal champions trained and can demo features
- Runbook in Confluence + first-week health check complete

Sophia L. (CSM): Risk: they requested HIPAA-ready logs by week 4 14 medium risk if Private deployment needed. Tagging Eng-Security.

Rahul P. (SE): I'll loop Eng-Security for compliance. Meanwhile request a redacted sample and exception matrix from customer.

Marta G. (AE): Note: customer expects pilot PO by week 2. If that slips, renewal risk rises. I'll follow up with procurement.

Eli T. (Onboarding): Proposed meeting blocks (will calendar):
- Kickoff (30m) Mon 10:00 PT
- Tech pairing (60m) Wed 9:00 PT weekly x4
- Enablement sprint (45m) Fri 11:00 PT weekly x6
- 30/60/90 reviews: D30/D60/D90 (30m)

Sophia L. (CSM): ops-bot can you create the channel and a calendar stub? I'll complete attendee list.

ops-bot: Created #cs-vervain-onboard and calendar "Vervain Labs - Onboarding Kickoff" Mon 10:00 PT (invite pending). :calendar:

Sophia L. (CSM): I'll drop the one-pager by EOD. Also want a short feedback form after each sprint 14 Eli, can you own it?

Eli T. (Onboarding): Yep. I'll create a Google form + Confluence page with three quick metrics: ease-of-use, latency satisfaction, blockers.

Rahul P. (SE): Prep checklist for kickoff:
- Request sandbox keys
- Upload redacted sample data to S3
- Network whitelisting contact info
- Example prompts/use-cases

Marta G. (AE): I'll add PO target to calendar and request narrow SLA list from procurement.

Sophia L. (CSM): Action items: owners confirm acceptance criteria and blockers by EOD tomorrow. I'll publish the one-pager and send invites after that. :thumbsup:
